name: blog-components
description: Shared, versioned design components for repo-per-customer blogs: layout chrome, post page, index, author pages, SEO metadata, JSON-LD, sitemap/RSS/robots, FAQ block, typography and the WCAG-guarded palette. Shipped as TypeScript source (the consuming Next.js app transpiles it), so a customer repo pins a tagged release as a git dependency with no build step and no registry auth.
